stations.title: Sacrae disciplinae leges promulgates the Code now in force

stations.instrument: Responsa ad proposita dubia, coetus plenarius 21 Martii, 29 Aprilis and 28 Februarii 1986 (Pastor bonus art. 154)

interpretation.answer: Answered in the terms the collection prints. It is attached here to the first canon of the three the heading names, because the heading names a range and this record does not divide one responsum into three.
interpretation.basis: Read in the Holy See's Latin collection Interpretationes Authenticae, sha256 1e7a0aaa..., at the block headed by this canon; the Dicastery for Legislative Texts serves the same Latin on its own page for this canon and the two were compared and found identical.
interpretation.question: A doubt on religious raised to the episcopate, headed in the collection as cann. 705-707 together.
